$comment: Re-cast plan for owner directive D3 ('modern, hip knowledge workers'). Applied in catalog 2.0.0 (28 September 2026) with the steps in catalog/ART-DIRECTION.md §8; kept as the record of every old and new name. Second rename, leads only (28 September 2026): the owner found the 12 Chief of Staff names too hard to remember, so each lead took a shorter, easier name; for those 12 entries new_name/new_handle hold the current name, interim_name/interim_handle the 2.0.0 name it replaced, and name_note why it was chosen. Faces, voices, pronouns, ages, looks and personalities did not change. Nothing in the apps reads this file. Ids never change; only name, handle, age_range, look, accent and portrait change.
